analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to buy from 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see. RSI at 59.0 has recovered to the neutral zone, and the 5-day low ($75.47) is higher than the 20-day low ($66.55), confirming the early stages of a Higher Low pattern. ADX at 13.3 indicates low trend strength, but the uptrend on the daily chart persists. 1x target allocation is complete, preparing for leverage entry.
